# Namrata Group

> > Namrata Group is a Pune-based real estate developer specializing in residential and commercial projects across Talegaon Dabhade, Hinjewadi, and West Pune.

Founded by Deepak Shah and Shailesh Shah, Namrata Group delivers affordable to luxury apartments including flagship projects like 32 Pinewood Drive, Slim Tower, Krushna Nagari, and Namrata Vasudha. The company serves first-time homebuyers and investors across Pune's growing IT corridors and suburban developments.
